name: sgs/separator
title: SGS Separator
description: A styleable horizontal divider — line style, responsive width/thickness, colour or gradient, alignment, and an optional centred icon or text label. Replaces core/separator framework-wide.

line.label: Line
line._note: The visible divider — the block ROOT itself when contentMode='none' (a single <hr>, no wrapper — single-semantic-element rule), or each `.sgs-separator__line` flanking span when contentMode is 'icon'/'text' (render.php: one mechanism renders the border-bottom for both shapes, module header). `thickness`/`lineStyle`/`colour` map onto css:border-width/style/color because the visible line IS rendered as a border-bottom (render.php:140-156), not a background bar — no css:background-color member resolves (honest gap: a line has no fill). `lineGradient` claims css:border-color-gradient (Spec 35 vocabulary fix, 2026-08-20) — renders as border-image in HTML, which is the only mechanism that preserves dashed/dotted gradients while respecting lineStyle. Note updated 2026-08-16 (D643): it previously named the gradientColourStart/End/Angle scalars, collapsed to the single `lineGradient` CSS string that session. No border-radius/box-shadow/max-width/height/gap/aspect-ratio attrs — honest gaps. No `layer` — a line has no children to arrange.

content.label: Content (icon or text)
content._note: Optional centred icon OR text label, shown when contentMode is 'icon'/'text' (render.php, `.sgs-separator__content`). css:color resolves to the UNIFIED `contentColour` (2026-07-23: contentIconColour + contentTextColour merged — the slot renders an icon OR text, never both, so one foreground colour serves both modes; the former two mode-split colour attrs both painted color on .sgs-separator__content and collided). Typography (contentFontSize/FontWeight/FontStyle/LineHeight) resolves via the default `content`+suffix convention. contentIconSize/contentIconSource/contentIconName/contentIconEmoji/contentIconDashicon/contentIconWpIcon are bespoke icon-source controls (honest orphans). text-transform/text-decoration/text-align/font-family have no content-specific attribute — honest gaps.

icon.label: Icon
icon._note: The `<span class="sgs-separator__icon">` glyph rendered inside `.sgs-separator__content` when contentMode='icon' (render.php:323-342). Added 2026-08-15 so `contentIconSize` (css_element='icon' in the DB — a genuinely distinct DOM node from the `content` element's own text/colour surface) has a manifest home; this audit only checks that the css_element STRING resolves to a declared key, so `clusters: []` is deliberate and unchanged in behaviour — `contentIconSize` remains an honest by-design orphan (a bespoke icon-size control, same treatment as sgs/icon-list's `iconSize` and sgs/icon's own `iconSize`), not a cluster member.
